image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates embedded in a textured, hairy girdle. The background consists of encrusted rock with pink coralline algae.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the animal blends smoothly into the girdle without protruding features.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Exactly eight distinct, overlapping plates are clearly visible running from anterior to posterior.
